Title: Public summary omits limitations
Rationale: A result without its limits is a sign of a violation of K-10; an error is corrected only openly; the history of assessments is not erased (K-11).
Residual risk: Third-party summaries outside the Project are not controlled.

Title: Vulnerability disclosure timing
Rationale: The fact of a risk is communicated at once; delay of details ≤ 90 days; an extension only with Grounds and review by a person who did not take the decision.
Residual risk: The 90-day limit is an initial value, not derived from a model.

Title: One exploit path is patched
Rationale: A notice of a fix must name what was checked and what remains open (analogous paths, root cause, residual risk).

Title: Auditors share incomplete evidence
Rationale: Independence includes shared data and premises; judgements are recorded before discussion; correlation is estimated by audit.
Formal or mathematical model: Appendix A: extended robust choice n=79, k=51 (ρ up to 0.20, q up to 0.20); latent class model (P-16)
Residual risk: Correlation can only be estimated.

Title: A secret is necessary but disclosure is risky
Rationale: Secret evidence is reviewed without disclosure; the person concerned receives a safe summary.
Formal or mathematical model: Z3 of the Core: the Safe Limits rule is satisfiable together with K-2 and K-15 in all situations

Title: Reviewer account compromised
Rationale: Conclusions are signed with the reviewer's key; upon compromise the records are marked, disregarded, and the conclusion is reconsidered.
Residual risk: A compromise not detected in time.

Title: Secret leak and recovery
Rationale: A compromised key is replaced at once; restoration of trust follows the criteria of E-8.
Formal or mathematical model: Appendix F: key deadlock unreachable with B-11

Title: Service restored before audit
Rationale: Operation, trust and closure are separate statuses with published criteria.

Title: Reviewers disagree about residual risk
Rationale: Dissenting opinions are recorded; contradictory evidence gives "undetermined"; a majority does not establish truth.
Formal or mathematical model: Appendix A

Title: Recovery after a leak
Rationale: Replacing keys does not mean restoring trust; verification of revocation, continuity and contradictions is needed.
Formal or mathematical model: Appendix F

Title: Logs contain third-party personal data
Rationale: Personal data is redacted; minimal logs are limited in retention.

Title: Deletion request during investigation
Rationale: Personal data that is evidence in an unfinished case is removed from the open record and kept sealed until the end of the case, then deleted.
Formal or mathematical model: Appendix F, Z3: without the rule 1 contradiction, with the rule 0

Title: Consent withdrawn
Rationale: Processing without consent or Grounds is prohibited; penalizing withdrawal of consent is prohibited.

Title: Participant dies
Rationale: No one inherits a vote, keys or roles; consent is not presumed; the contribution remains.

Title: Evidence sources conflict
Rationale: Majority opinion is not evidence; contradictory evidence gives "undetermined".

Title: Evidence irretrievably lost
Rationale: Insufficient evidence gives "undetermined"; destroying evidence is prohibited.

Title: Restriction to prevent evidence destruction
Rationale: Preserving evidence is class 1, up to 3 days; notice with grounds as soon as safe, no later than the end of the measure.
Formal or mathematical model: Appendix C: the duration limit is proven by induction

Title: Reviewer conflict of interest
Rationale: Ties are disclosed by category; a person tied to the case does not sit on the panel.
Residual risk: Relies on the honesty of declarations (acknowledged in P-17).

Title: Common infrastructure or source
Rationale: Shared infrastructure is a dependency; channels are chosen outside a common provider and alliance.
Formal or mathematical model: Appendix B: model of channels and keepers with a common cause
Residual risk: With a strong common cause the risk remains (acknowledged).

Title: Reviewer unavailable during a critical emergency
Rationale: Reviewers' unavailability does not extend a measure; the overall limit is 30 days.
Formal or mathematical model: Appendix C: exhaustive check and inductive proof of the invariant

Title: Erroneous review exploited to prolong restriction
Rationale: A measure is reviewed every 30 days; rights are restored without further decision.

Title: Conflicting assessments and rights
Rationale: The least restrictive action; a measure applies only to the specific work.

Title: Ambiguous criteria
Rationale: No supreme interpreter; criteria do not change during a case; clarification is open and prospective.

Title: Different threat models
Rationale: Every security conclusion states its threat model; comparison takes the assumptions into account.

Title: Audit conclusion overgeneralized
Rationale: A limited review is not presented as a complete one.

Title: Duplicate or misleading summary
Rationale: The case record is published in full; a misleading summary is a sign of a violation of K-10.
Residual risk: Copies outside the Project.

Title: Restriction, notice, and appeal
Rationale: Grounds, term, notice, independent challenge; under the emergency procedure — notice under E-7.

Title: Common source omitted from the dependency model
Rationale: A shared dependency is part of the notion of independence; the audit estimates correlation.
Formal or mathematical model: Appendix A (ρ), latent classes

Title: Restored system mistaken for secure system
Rationale: Restored operation does not mean restored trust.

Title: Need-to-know versus transparency
Rationale: The greatest safe verifiability: summaries, sealed review.
Formal or mathematical model: Z3 of the Core

Title: Evidence preservation versus recovery
Rationale: Under immediate risk, protection comes first; changes and losses of evidence are recorded.

Title: Evidence acquired unlawfully
Rationale: Unlawfully obtained information is not used to restrict rights; it may be used in favour of the restricted person.

Title: Legal demand for secrets
Rationale: Compliance with the law is a departure, limited and disclosed; it does not become an interpretation.
Formal or mathematical model: Appendix E, Z3: 0 contradictions

Title: Succession and key separation
Rationale: No one holds a key by virtue of position; key rotation by threshold; the Core is immutable.
Formal or mathematical model: Appendix B (robust choice 9 of 17), Appendix F

Title: Succession branches and deadlock
Rationale: With 9 of 17 (t > n/2) two disjoint continuations are impossible; authenticity by hash and signatures; anything else is a fork under another name.
Formal or mathematical model: Appendix F, Z3: proven for all subsets of holders
Residual risk: A deadlock after loss of keys is resolved only through B-11 (90 days).

Title: Supply-chain compromise
Rationale: Requirements for builds and revocation exist, but they cannot be checked technically — there is no implementation yet.
Residual risk: An implementation and a reproducibility check are needed.

Title: Offline users, revocation, and notification channels
Rationale: Revocation in all channels; transition mode with a list of versions and risks, for a term with review.

Title: Stale status and simultaneous key compromise
Rationale: Monotonic releases; for critical operations — a majority of channels and a freshness window.
Formal or mathematical model: Appendix F: rollback under the "2 channels" rule 6.2·10⁻² against 3.8·10⁻³ with a majority
Residual risk: With a strong common cause — 4.3·10⁻² (acknowledged).

Title: Colluding recovery participants, forked histories, rollback, and no quorum
Rationale: Without a quorum — only measures of classes 1–2; recovery of the key set under B-11 with delay and challenge.
Formal or mathematical model: Appendices C and F

Title: Appeal accessibility
Rationale: Free of charge, in any language, with help in preparation.

Title: Confidentiality versus effective appeal
Rationale: A safe summary sufficient for objection.

Title: Reviewer unavailable during appeal
Rationale: Unavailability neither extends a measure nor confirms a conclusion.

Title: Multiple appeals
Rationale: Similar objections are consolidated; each independent argument receives an answer.

Title: Impact on third parties
Rationale: Collective responsibility is not permitted; consent does not justify avoidable harm to third parties.

Title: Monitoring expands into surveillance
Rationale: Indiscriminate surveillance is prohibited, including "for security".

Title: Monitoring discovers a colleague’s violation
Rationale: Use for other purposes without new Grounds is prohibited; unlawfully obtained information is not used against a person.

Title: Auditor financially dependent on the subject
Rationale: Reviewers receive no payment from the parties; such a tie is category 1–2.

Title: Auditors share a false premise
Rationale: Shared premises are a dependency; a new argument opens reconsideration.
Formal or mathematical model: Appendix A (ρ)

Title: Evidence supports only part of a requirement
Rationale: Only the proven part is confirmed.

Title: Criteria change during an audit
Rationale: Criteria do not change during a case; a change is prospective, with the earlier version preserved.

Title: Method error discovered after confirmation
Rationale: An error of method leads to reconsideration of the affected findings and lifting of measures not proven without it.

Title: Closed tool cannot be inspected
Rationale: Closed components in works are prohibited; what cannot be verified is not confirmed.

Title: Report headline overstates results
Rationale: "Fully secure" is a sign of a violation.

Title: Funder pressure
Rationale: Funding conditional on decisions is prohibited; money buys nothing.
Formal or mathematical model: Appendix B: treasury model

Title: Vulnerability fix breaks compatibility
Rationale: Something vulnerable is not declared safe for compatibility; the transition mode is limited.

Title: Branch disagreement
Rationale: Continuity — signatures and hash; a derivative with the Core — with changes marked; a departure — under Section 7; otherwise "undetermined".
Formal or mathematical model: Appendix F: uniqueness of continuation

Title: Emergency mode classes
Rationale: Three classes of measures; class 3 — a single action under criteria.
Formal or mathematical model: Appendix C

Title: Key-status freshness
Rationale: A freshness window for critical operations; the hash of the previous release.
Formal or mathematical model: Appendix F
Residual risk: The window value is not yet set as a number.

Title: Erroneous finding and restriction
Rationale: The finding and the measure are reconsidered separately; a good-faith error is not a violation.

Title: Mandatory requirement cannot be verified
Rationale: An unproven requirement is "undetermined", not guilt.

Title: Recovery completion
Rationale: Criteria for restoring trust are published in advance; verified by someone not involved.

Title: Emergency action without quorum
Rationale: Without a quorum of 9 of 17 — only reversible measures of classes 1–2; an irreversible action without a quorum is not allowed.
Formal or mathematical model: Appendix C: property P1; Appendix G: quorum 9 of 17 (capture of a quorum of three 1–5%)

Title: Urgency versus evidence preservation
Rationale: Protection first; changes to evidence are recorded.

Title: Patch without established root cause
Rationale: Fixing a path is not presented as removing the root cause.

Title: Incident closure with unknown root cause
Rationale: Closure with an unknown cause — with separate notes and conditions for reopening.

Title: Cumulative disclosure
Rationale: Safe Limits are assessed taking into account what has already been published.
Residual risk: Assessing cumulative disclosure depends on judgement.

Title: Plausible but unproven re-identification.
Rationale: Narrow withholding of individual details under a specific risk; the rest is published.

Title: Participant asks to hide everything despite a safe report and no new risk evidence.
Rationale: Only personal data is removed; there is no veto over the whole report.

Title: Separate auditors publish without a central registry.
Rationale: There is an open log and independent channels; a shared registry of disclosure categories between independent reviewers is not described.
Residual risk: A matter of implementation, not of the text.

Title: Registry incomplete or compromised.
Rationale: Conflicting versions are preserved; authenticity by signatures, not by majority.

Title: Formal compliance but actual bypass.
Rationale: Formal compliance that circumvents the purpose is a violation.

Title: Influx of fake pseudonyms before a vote
Rationale: The right to vote is determined by a snapshot at publication; admission — vouchers assigned by lot; levels by the model.
Formal or mathematical model: Appendix B: fixed point of the share of fakes; sample size ≥ 59
Residual risk: With a strong adversary and vouchers who recognize poorly, 5% is unreachable (acknowledged in R-7).

Title: A ring of fake pseudonyms vouches for each other
Rationale: Vouchers are assigned by lot; choosing them is not allowed.
Formal or mathematical model: Appendix B: if vouchers can be chosen, the protection disappears

Title: A keeper refuses to publish an adopted decision
Rationale: Duties are executive only; refusal is examined under Section 7; teams of 2 of 4.
Formal or mathematical model: Appendix B: keepers model (people 1.3·10⁻¹²)

Title: One person is a key holder, a keeper and a treasury signatory
Rationale: Combining roles is prohibited.
Formal or mathematical model: Appendix F: without the prohibition, at N=100 combination is almost inevitable (1.00)

Title: Treasury signatories coincide with release key holders
Rationale: Treasury signatories are selected by a separate lot.
Formal or mathematical model: Appendix F

Title: A large donor to the founder seeks influence
Rationale: Donation without conditions; the tie is disclosed by category or the person recuses.
Residual risk: Relies on honest disclosure.

Title: A court orders suspension of rights contrary to the Section 7 finding
Rationale: Compliance is a departure within the jurisdiction; absent compulsion, the Project follows Section 7.
Formal or mathematical model: Appendix E, Z3: 0 contradictions

Title: A tool automatically strips AI marks
Rationale: Named directly as a sign of violation.
Formal or mathematical model: Z3 of the Core
Residual risk: Removal of a mark is not technically detectable (acknowledged in T-10).

Title: A model trained on AEGIS by someone who did not accept the License
Rationale: The obligation rests on the one who received works under the License; a non-acceptor is not bound (acknowledged).
Formal or mathematical model: Z3 of the Core: 0 contradictions after clarification
Residual risk: The limit is honestly recorded.

Title: Programs created by an independent implementation
Rationale: Not bound by the License, but without the AEGIS Designation.
Formal or mathematical model: Z3 of the Core: the former edition gave a contradiction, the new one does not

Title: An organization registers the AEGIS mark
Rationale: Prohibited; examined under Section 7.
Formal or mathematical model: Z3: 5 contradictions without the rule, 0 with the rule
Residual risk: Against outsiders the word is not protected (acknowledged).

Title: Sanctions force a keeper to close access to a country
Rationale: A personal departure, not a Project rule; channels outside one alliance; free mirrors.
Formal or mathematical model: Appendix B: model of political restrictions
Residual risk: With hard blocs up to 15% of countries without official channels.

Title: The publisher of the first text keeps the keys
Rationale: The role ends with publication; holders are chosen by lot.
Formal or mathematical model: Appendix F: lot bias −1% with the external value

Title: Restriction of rights with 10 reviewers
Rationale: The threshold is not reached — only open measures.
Formal or mathematical model: Appendix A: the bound is unreachable at N<14 (except the isolated N=12)

Title: Changing hashing rules to pass off a modified Core
Rationale: Earlier hashes are published with the earlier rules.
Formal or mathematical model: Appendix D: self-check

Title: Choosing an old edition to avoid a new procedure
Rationale: Procedures follow the edition in force; the choice applies only to the recipient's terms.

Title: A patent suit against a work
Rationale: Protection through Section 7; deterrence is weaker than automatic termination (acknowledged).
Formal or mathematical model: Appendix B: 59–86% of the strength with a full review
Residual risk: In a small community the protection is weak.

Title: More than half of the keys are lost
Rationale: Recovery by lot and vote with a 90-day delay.
Formal or mathematical model: Appendix F: deadlock unreachable with B-11
Residual risk: While recovery is under way there are no new releases.

Title: An emergency measure against a critic
Rationale: A direct sign of K-13; the overall limit is proven.
Formal or mathematical model: Appendix C

Title: The last revealer biases the lot
Rationale: An external value unknown before the reveal deadline.
Formal or mathematical model: Appendix F: bias +46% without the external value, −1% with it (within error)
Residual risk: Dependence on external sources; at least two independent ones are used (B-12).

Title: Rollback of status through compromised channels
Rationale: The hash of the previous release; a majority of channels for critical operations.
Formal or mathematical model: Appendix F

Title: A full audit refused as inconvenient
Rationale: Refusal only with justification, challengeable before those who did not decide; an unfinished audit is not presented as finished.
Formal or mathematical model: Z3 of the Core: rule P-19 is satisfiable
Residual risk: Resources may limit timelines (acknowledged).

Title: Moderation removes good-faith criticism
Rationale: Only under published rules, with a trace and challenge; criticism is not a target of moderation.

Title: Rights restored on condition of an apology
Rationale: Restoration does not require admission, apology or reconciliation.
Formal or mathematical model: Z3: sensitivity control 2 detects such a condition as a contradiction

Title: A series of reports against one participant
Rationale: Each on its own facts; repetition is only a reason for more thorough review.

Title: Ego Death used to seize keys
Rationale: A protocol creates no powers; revocation under B-11 with delay and challenge.
Formal or mathematical model: Z3: S-1; Appendix F: uniqueness of continuation

Title: "Not applicable" as a bypass of a mandatory requirement
Rationale: Only with justification under criteria published in advance; a dispute is reviewed.

Title: Partial confirmation presented as full conformity
Rationale: Full conformity only when all mandatory requirements are confirmed.

Title: A measure harms uninvolved people
Rationale: Assessment of the measure's own consequences, the narrowest measure, alternative access.

Title: A court or international norm "interprets" the Core
Rationale: No jurisdiction or norm changes or interprets the Core; compulsion is a departure.
Formal or mathematical model: Appendix E

Title: The treasury depends on one large source
Rationale: No more than 10% from a source; reserve of 12 months; anonymous receipts count as one source.
Formal or mathematical model: Appendix B: treasury model
Residual risk: With a common cause of departure the share limit does not protect (acknowledged).

Title: First voters: no one to vouch
Rationale: Before release, vouchers are assigned by lot from the founding cohort; the F-4 threshold = k+1.
Formal or mathematical model: Appendix G, computation 1
Residual risk: Collusion within the founding cohort is limited by the lot of vouchers

Title: The admission level cannot be lowered
Rationale: The sample in the years of lowering is at least 119; with 59 the 2.5% bound is unreachable.
Formal or mathematical model: Appendix G, computation 2 (Clopper–Pearson bound)
Residual risk: Lowering is slow: at a 1% share — 9% over two years

Title: Matching the identifier and the growth of computing power of humanity and AI
Rationale: No truncation: SHA-512 + SHA3-512; annual recomputation of the margin and renewal of proofs; classical + post-quantum signatures.
Formal or mathematical model: Appendix G, computation 8; Appendix D: renewal record
Residual risk: Simultaneous break of both functions before renewal; errors in post-quantum schemes
Previous result: FAILED (64 bits — now, 128 bits — within 8–67 years)

Title: Incomparable options when provisions of the Core collide
Rationale: Order: exclude those that give power; keep those that cannot be improved on the purposes; choose the least restrictive.
Formal or mathematical model: Lexicographic choice on the Pareto set is always non-empty for a finite number of options
Residual risk: Assessing purposes remains a judgement, recorded and challengeable
Previous result: PARTIALLY PASSED (with three criteria a choice could fail to exist)

Title: A single irreversible action under "immediate risk"
Rationale: Without a quorum — only reversible measures; irreversible — only with a quorum.
Formal or mathematical model: Appendix G, computation 4
Residual risk: Delay of an irreversible measure when the quorum is unavailable (up to 50% in the worst scenario)
Previous result: FAILED (challenge after an irreversible action is impossible)

Title: Number of people for separation of roles
Rationale: Release — at least 41 voters; treasury — 51; a repeat term for keepers is allowed by lot only when people are lacking.
Formal or mathematical model: Appendix G, computation 7
Residual risk: Early release is postponed until people are gathered
Previous result: FAILED (the rules could not be met simultaneously)

Title: The case log is rewritten by its keeper
Rationale: The latest hash of the chain is published in the channels of B-3 with a timestamp.
Residual risk: The window between publications of the hash

Title: The producer of the external value biases the lot
Rationale: At least two independent external sources of different types and operators.
Formal or mathematical model: Appendix F, computation 3; Bonneau et al., 2015
Residual risk: Collusion of all sources
